title: Migrate gaja to use fieldwork crate
description: Replace inline duplicated modules with fieldwork crate dependencies. Gaja is ~17K lines with modules that duplicate fieldwork functionality.
close_reason: Migrated gaja to fieldwork crate. Replaced id.rs, auth.rs, db.rs (Pool + schema), delivery.rs (retry + circuit_breaker). Updated all Postgres SQL paths from TIMESTAMPTZ to INTEGER timestamps. Net -883 lines. All 34 tests pass.
